name: Mock Turtle
timbre: deep, hollow, mournful man's voice, wet and tremulous, breaking with sighs and sobs
pitch: low bass, slow sliding cadence, lurching up into a quavering tenor when he gets excited
accent: genteel, old-fashioned upper-middle-class English, plummy and careful
reference_style: Melancholy old boy of a genteel school: slow tearful speech broken by sighs, sudden wild delight over the Lobster Quadrille, touchy snaps when his schooling is slighted. Sings 'Beautiful Soup' in a voice sometimes choked with sobs. The 'distant sobs' of ch012-p69 are his.

choked_sobbing.note: ch010-p01 'sobs choked his voice'; ch010-p75 'a voice sometimes choked with sobs'

voice_evidence.quote: said the Mock Turtle in a deep, hollow tone
began, in a voice sometimes choked with sobs, to sing this
